purpose: Steps 2-4 of blueprints/us-equities/engine-nautilus/acceptance-plan.md section 5 (IBKR paper) on the NautilusTrader 1.231.0 Python Interactive Brokers adapter (official ibapi), the latest release not blocked by nautilus_trader#4983 or rust-ibapi#764. Frozen before the first order; any deviation is recorded in the receipt.
authorization: Standing user authorization for paper E2E and paper orders (agent-lab AGENTS.md). No live account, live port or paid data.

runtime.lock: requirements.lock (uv pip compile --generate-hashes; installed with uv pip sync --require-hashes)

endpoint.application: IB Gateway 10.50 (Windows, signed in to paper by the user; reached from WSL over mirrored networking)
endpoint.account_rule: every managed account starts with DU (paper); anything else stops the run before any other request
endpoint.client_id_rule: 81 and 82 are used only by this plan and never concurrently with each other's other role; 73 and 76 belong to another session and are never used

data_mode.use: Only to price the resting limit orders 10% below the reference; no case needs a real-time feed, and market orders fill at the paper simulator's price.

start_conditions: IB Gateway reachable at 127.0.0.1:4002 and every managed account starts with DU
zero positions and zero open orders in every managed account (flat start); otherwise exit 4 and submit nothing
a SPY reference price no older than max_reference_quote_age_s

cases.name: submit, acknowledge, cancel
cases.steps: LIMIT BUY 1 SPY at the resting price, DAY -> ACCEPTED -> cancel -> CANCELED

cases.name: fill and flatten
cases.steps: MARKET BUY 1 -> FILLED; MARKET SELL 1 -> FILLED; net position 0

cases.name: kill switch
cases.steps: Nautilus risk engine trading state HALTED -> MARKET BUY 1 -> OrderDenied with no broker submission -> state ACTIVE

cases.name: reconnect with an open order
cases.steps: run 1: LIMIT BUY 1 at the resting price -> ACCEPTED, node stopped with the order left open; run 2: new process with reconciliation -> the same venue order id is open in the cache -> cancel -> CANCELED

cases.name: restart reconciliation
cases.steps: run 2 startup reconciliation reports net SPY position 0 and exactly the C3 order open, matching the broker

end_disposition: Cancel every open order this plan created; flatten any SPY position with a MARKET order (counted toward the order cap; if the cap is reached, stop and report blocked); postcheck must show zero positions and zero open orders.
reconciliation_rule: Every journal fill matches one IB execution (execId) for client id 82 with equal side, quantity and price, and one commission report; order ids map client_order_id -> IB order id/permId. Money in USD, rounded to cents; commissions are taken from IB commission reports. A missing commission or an unresolved id makes the result blocked, not passed.
kill_switch_and_alert: Kill switch: C5, plus the abort path (any reject, unexpected fill, bound breach or timeout cancels all orders, flattens and stops). Alerts: the adaptive-paper metrics exporter and Prometheus rules are not wired to this arm, so alerting is not exercised here and is reported as not exercised.
pass_rule: Every case observed as declared, zero duplicate submissions, zero unexplained position/open-order/cash differences at postcheck, no bound breach, all fills matched with commissions. Anything else is fail or blocked, recorded as observed.
privacy: No account id, balance or hash of either is published; raw node logs stay in host-only state; published journals replace account ids with DU<redacted>.
